notes.title: Instarion Trailer And Update
notes.content: [p]We just finished a playtest (thank you all for participating!) and are excited to present an updated [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248010/Instarion/"]Steam page[/url]: new trailer, bunch of screenshots, and fresh details about the game! [/p][p]In the near future, I will be fully focusing on further development of the new version of the game (as in the video and screenshots), which I have been working on since last summer. I will share more details later.[/p]

notes.title: Instarion Playtest V2 | September 13
notes.content: [p][/p][h3]Hello, everyone![/h3][p]On September 13 (15:00 CET / 9AM EST) we’re launching the two-day long playtest of the [b]current[/b] version (V2) of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248010/Instarion/"]Instarion[/url] to get feedback and gameplay data [b]before[/b] the huge update.[/p][p][/p][h3]Key features of V2:[/h3][list][*][p]PvE-coop space sim shooter on a single server[/p][/*][*][p]Totally seamless universe[/p][/*][*][p]Huge spherical planets[/p][/*][*][p]Unlimited distances and speeds[/p][/*][*][p]Ship interiors with nested ships[/p][/*][*][p]Ship boarding and spacewalks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And in the beginning of October we’ll introduce the new version (V3) of Instarion, entirely recreated completly from scratch. There we’ll introduce [b]MASSIVE[/b] space and ground battles with hundreds and thousands of units. All the rest key features remain the same and even more optimized than before.[/p][p][i]P.S. If you've tried V2 earlier this year, please wait for the next playtest of V3, it's going to be really cool.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Join the playtest [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248010/Instarion/"]here[/url] (everyone gets access at launch).[/b][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248010/Instarion/" style="button" buttoncolor="#0080ff"]Steam[/url]   [url="https://discord.gg/2N4TpCzt" style="button" buttoncolor="#5865f2"]Discord[/url]   [url="https://www.youtube.com/@instarion" style="button" buttoncolor="#b2071d"]YouTube[/url][/p]

notes.title: Instarion Playtest Update v.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’re releasing [url=https://s.team/a/2248010]Instarion Playtest Update v.0.2[/url]!
We’ve added and improved a lot of new systems and contents: ground and space combat, quests, looting, trading, mining, new transport, weapons, enemies and many other things ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2476440/view/530962536730723286]patch note[/url]).
You could also follow the development and track all the future updates in our [url=https://trello.com/b/kZKKAdZc/instarion-roadmap]roadmap[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/2W6zS2eqGv]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Playtest is live!
notes.content:
You can visit different locations, fight bots and other players, buy new transport and fly together with your friends.

We would like to test few technical elements and would be grateful for your feedback.

Playtest: https://s.team/a/2248010

notes.title: Instarion Playtest — July 2023
notes.content:
We’re launching our first playtest in early July! 
Pretty much nothing is ready, so it’s mostly to test a few technical elements.

During playtest you’ll be able to move between planets, visit several locations, try some basic fighting, buy and upgrade your transport, and do all that together with your friends.

Fell free to apply for Playtest on our Steam page, we would be grateful for any feedback!
